Data and library loading: Data is loaded from the OpenF1 API.
```{r}
# ==========================================================
# OpenF1 Grand Prix EDA (2022–2024) with Rate-Limit Handling
# ==========================================================

library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)

# ---- Setup ----
if (!dir.exists("data")) dir.create("data")
if (!dir.exists("plots")) dir.create("plots")

# ---- User Option: Include Sprint Races ----
include_sprints <- FALSE  # Change to TRUE to include sprint sessions

# ---- Orange-based color palette ----
orange_pal <- colorRampPalette(c("#7C2D12", "#C2410C", "#F97316", "#FDBA74", "#FFEDD5"))(30)

theme_orange <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(color = "#E65100", face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "#E65100"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "#5D4037"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(color = "#C2410C"),
      legend.text = element_text(color = "#7C2D12"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

# ---- Robust API Fetch with Rate-Limit Handling ----
fetch_openf1 <- function(endpoint, query = list(), retries = 5, delay = 5) {
  base_url <- paste0("https://api.openf1.org/v1/", endpoint)
  
  for (i in seq_len(retries)) {
    res <- GET(base_url, query = query)
    status <- status_code(res)
    
    if (status == 200) {
      data <- fromJSON(content(res, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"), flatten = TRUE)
      if (is.data.frame(data)) return(data)
      tryCatch({
        df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(data, as.data.frame, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
        return(df)
      }, error = function(e) data.frame())
    } else if (status == 429) {
      message(paste0("⏳ Rate limit hit. Waiting ", delay, " seconds before retry..."))
      Sys.sleep(delay)
      delay <- delay * 2  # exponential backoff
    } else if (status == 400) {
      stop("Bad Request (HTTP 400): Check endpoint or query parameters.")
    } else if (status == 401) {
      stop("Unauthorized (HTTP 401): Check your base URL (should be https://api.openf1.org/v1/).")
    } else {
      stop_for_status(res)
    }
  }
  
  warning(paste("Failed to fetch:", endpoint))
  return(data.frame())
}

# ---- Connection Check ----
cat("Checking API connection...\n")
test_res <- try(fetch_openf1("meetings", query = list(year = 2024)), silent = TRUE)
if (inherits(test_res, "try-error")) stop("❌ API connection failed. Check internet or endpoint URL.")
cat("✅ Connection successful!\n")

# ---- Parameters ----
years <- 2022:2024

# ---- Fetch Meeting Data ----
cat("Fetching meetings data...\n")
meetings_cache <- "data/meetings_2022_2024.rds"
if (file.exists(meetings_cache)) {
  meetings <- readRDS(meetings_cache)
} else {
  meetings <- map_dfr(years, function(yr) {
    Sys.sleep(1)  # small delay to avoid rate-limit
    fetch_openf1("meetings", query = list(year = yr))
  })
  saveRDS(meetings, meetings_cache)
}

meetings <- meetings %>%
  select(meeting_key, year, circuit_short_name, location, country_name, date_start, meeting_name) %>%
  mutate(
    date_start = suppressWarnings(ymd(date_start, quiet = TRUE)),
    year = as.integer(year)
  )

# ---- Fetch Sessions ----
cat("Fetching session data...\n")
sessions_cache <- "data/sessions_2022_2024.rds"
if (file.exists(sessions_cache)) {
  sessions <- readRDS(sessions_cache)
} else {
  sessions <- map_dfr(meetings$meeting_key, function(key) {
    Sys.sleep(1)  # small delay to avoid rate-limit
    fetch_openf1("sessions", query = list(meeting_key = key))
  })
  saveRDS(sessions, sessions_cache)
}

# ---- Filter Only Race Sessions ----
race_sessions <- sessions %>%
  filter(
    tolower(session_name) == "race" |
    tolower(session_type) == "race" |
    (include_sprints & grepl("sprint", tolower(session_name)))
  )

# Remove testing, practice, qualifying
race_sessions <- race_sessions %>%
  filter(!grepl("test|practice|qualifying", tolower(session_name)))

# ---- Join Race Sessions with Meetings ----
race_meetings <- meetings %>%
  semi_join(race_sessions, by = "meeting_key")

# ---- Fetch Lap Data for Sample Sessions ----
lap_cache <- "data/lap_data_sample.rds"
if (file.exists(lap_cache)) {
  laps <- readRDS(lap_cache)
} else {
  set.seed(123)
  sample_sessions <- sample(unique(race_sessions$session_key), size = min(3, nrow(race_sessions)))
  laps <- map_dfr(sample_sessions, function(skey) {
    Sys.sleep(1)
    fetch_openf1("laps", query = list(session_key = skey))
  })
  saveRDS(laps, lap_cache)
}

# ---- Summarize Lap Data ----
lap_summary <- laps %>%
  group_by(session_key, driver_number) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_lap_time = mean(lap_duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    fastest_lap = min(lap_duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---- Plot 1: Average Lap Time by Session ----
ggplot(lap_summary, aes(x = as.factor(session_key),
                        y = avg_lap_time,
                        color = as.factor(driver_number))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = orange_pal, name = "Driver #") +
  labs(title = "Average Lap Time by Race Session",
       x = "Session Key",
       y = "Average Lap Time (s)") +
  theme_orange()
ggsave("plots/lap_time_by_session.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# ---- Plot 2: Number of Official Races per Year ----
races_per_year <- race_meetings %>%
  count(year)

ggplot(races_per_year, aes(x = factor(year), y = n, fill = factor(year))) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = orange_pal[1:3]) +
  labs(title = paste0("Number of Official Grands Prix per Year (2022–2024)",
                      ifelse(include_sprints, " (Including Sprints)", "")),
       x = "Year",
       y = "Race Count") +
  theme_orange()
ggsave("plots/races_per_year.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# ---- Plot 3: Fastest Lap Distribution ----
ggplot(lap_summary, aes(x = fastest_lap, fill = as.factor(driver_number))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = orange_pal) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Fastest Laps (2022–2024)",
       x = "Fastest Lap Time (s)",
       y = "Count",
       fill = "Driver #") +
  theme_orange()
ggsave("plots/fastest_lap_distribution.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

cat("✅ All plots generated successfully in 'plots/' folder.\n")
```
